caption_L1: Myanmar : Youth unemployment rate from 1999 to 2020 is a line chart. The y-axis shows Youth unemployment rate while the x-axis measures Year.
caption_L2L3: Youth unemployment rates were stable from 1999 until about 2008. There was then a slight rise up until the year 2015. In 2015 there was a sharp increase of about 250%, a slight fall in 2016, and a further sharp increase between 2017 and 2020.
